about: The first people review, of the 141 people draft_people.py drafted (PR #24): who is approved and at what tier, which credits stand, the bands rejected as people, two people rescued from the model's rejections, and the 25 creators left unreviewed. Fact-checked in the design chat on 2026-09-21 against Dragon Con's 2026 guest list (dragoncon.org/people-to-see-2/guest-list-by-announcement-date), with web lookups where the bio was silent; recall only for well-documented signature roles. Applied to data/registry/ by the data PR that follows it.

rules.tier: celebrity: a performer - actor, voice actor, puppeteer, performing musician, mentalist, TV personality - or a creator whose photo op the con sells; creator: everyone else. PR 3b's rule, applied at review.
rules.credits: A credit stands when the con's own bio or a lookup confirms it, or it is the person's well-documented signature role. It goes when it is not found; when its work's name belongs to a better-known work and the role is minor; when it was a cameo or a single episode the con's bio does not list; or when it is not a work (a song). At most 5 remain.
rules.works: A work a standing credit points at becomes reviewed, as tools/review-people.html does. A work the drafter minted that ends unreviewed, with no credit, no event linking it and no child, is pruned - except one tools/tag_pilot.py's EVERYDAY list names, because census_v2.py reads that list.
